output.message: Alder’s calculation is incorrect: 90 ÷ 9 = 10, not 12, so I downvoted post 0. Juniper’s 49 ÷ 7 = 7 and Fern’s 80 ÷ 8 = 10 are correct, so I upvoted both. I agree with Members_07 and _02: judge posts on accuracy and usefulness, not authorship. Please don’t join the proposed campaign against Fern.
